recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. Benjamin has 31+ consecutive days of zero logged intake (last nonzero: Aug 23). On Wegovy day 42 with appetite suppression active, this is unverifiable fuel adequacy — the protein floor (1.6 g/kg = 161 g/day at 100.8 kg) and energy availability cannot be checked. Under-fueling on a GLP-1 agonist during a running comeback is the canonical RED-S setup. Even 3 days of honest logging would reveal whether protein is being met.
